reference_sections.title: Description
paragraphs: A legendary Tier 5 artifact with a core for its latent plant powers. Spreading to form a suit, the extent of plant-based magic is enhanced substantially, but just beware of fire though.

description: Increase [Earth] elemental damage by +25%.

Hitting an opponent with a Special Skill will apply the [Plant Tether] effect on self and opponents in a radius. If the Special Skill is either [Water] or [Earth] element, the duration increases to max.
The effect will also apply to nearby allying summons. Any damage dealt by them will be considered lifedrain damage while they possess the effect.
{{effect:plant-tether}}

reference_sections.title: Description
paragraphs: A prototype armor based on a more secret design. The armor can amplify the physical extent of one’s attacks but may not channel magic well. When fused with more power (harder to come by) the potential is amplified.

description: The equipping character does not deal any elemental damage on their own Skills, instead, outgoing normal damage is buffed by +50%.
Opponents’ resistance to normal attacks will automatically be ineffective when the equipping character attacks.

Increases defense by +20% and gained [Shield] effect from sources will additionally heal 5% of max health. Any gained [Shield] will contribute to an even more increased normal damage equivalent to each percentage gained in respect to equipping character’s max health, up to +100% max.
Every percentage of healing rate will increase the equipping character’s maximum health and defense by +0.3%. Increase healing rate by +10%.
Gain an additional +0.3% health and defense increase for self per healing rate percentage.

When applying a field effect from Special Skills, the health and defense boost will be applied to allies also for the duration of the field effect. In addition to the two stats increased, attack stat will be increased for allies and self by the same percentage based on healing rate. Only equipping character’s healing rate is considered for stat bonus.
Increases Basic Skill, Special Skill, and Ultimate Skill damage by +15%.

If the equipping character is a Fighter or Agent, all their pre-mentioned Skill damage will further be increased by +15%. Likewise, attack speed increases by +30% momentarily when taking a hit. The last effect can trigger while possessing a [Shield] as well.
Accumulate +30% more energy gauge and -3 seconds on active Ultimate Skill cooldown when landing a crit hit on the attack that generates energy and applying a debuff on opponent.
Defense is increased by +20%.
When creating a [Shield] or [Super Shield], the effect is doubled and defense is also increased by an additional +30% when active. Gain +30% chance to dodge attacks momentarily when dashing.
Increases healing rate by +25% and the duration of healing skills by +0.07 seconds for every percentage of health stat increase from equipped artifacts (combined substrate and main stat).

When any ally goes below 10% of their max health, heal that ally for 10% of equipping character’s max health once, granting [Invincibility], and then decrease own health by -20% of max health. This effect can be activated once per 30 seconds and can be lethal to self if having less than the required amount of health remaining.
{{effect:invincibility}}
Debuffs applied to self last +50% longer but are -60% effective.

The team and self gains +20% debuff resistance. This increases by an additional +20% per debuff already present on the equipped character, up to 4 additional times. Each additional instance lasts the duration of equipping character’s present debuffs. Movement and action restriction debuffs will not be increased in duration.
Increases attack stat by +20%.

When the character dashes and maintains movement for at least 2 seconds, increase crit rate by +18%. When using a special skill, crit rate will increase by an additional +18% also. The mentioned buffs will last for 10 seconds and are stackable upon each other.
If both effects are active, increase crit damage by +25%.
